summary: Sub-block F (eps 90-95) is six straight canon rows adapting printed chapters 310-332 in strict running order, with no reorder and no anime-original material (coco13 calls every one of the six ほぼ原作通り). Ep 90 closes tankobon v33 exactly (313 裁きは下った…! = Killvearn's self-destruction), ep 91 opens v34 (314 バーン最大の謎), and the block ends with ep 95 entering v36's first chapter (332 響く闇からの声). Four rows end mid-chapter (91/92/93/95) and take C1 parity continues; 90 and 94 end on a chapter's last page and need none. THE NUMBERING FINDING: dragonquest.fandom's per-episode `adapted` field in this range is ALREADY the printed number — the wave-14 contract's blanket 'fandom N ≥ 208 = printed N − 1' does NOT hold and applying it would put every row one chapter low. Proven three ways: the fandom's own chapter page 122 = 決勝戦の異変!! (printed 122, not the 番外編) and 196 = さらば我が子よ; its volume page lists v33 = 私が最強だ…裁きは下った (9 chapters = printed 305-313) and v22/v37 with NO extra chapter anywhere; and ep 94's own title 絆にかけて is printed 327, which sits inside the unshifted range 324-327 and outside the shifted one. The same defect is visible BELOW my fence: the landed wave-13 anchors for eps 57/58/59 are one chapter low (coco13 prints explicit 話数 for eps 56-60 and Toei's synopses confirm the beats) — repairs proposed. The fandom's fields DO gain +1 at the very top (its ep-100 field ends at 349, one past printed 348); the drift is not present anywhere in 90-95 and first appears at the ep 97/98 seam (its 339 = printed 338).

Faithfulness clause (T28, Sean 2026-09-02): all six rows are faithful adaptations — coco13 records only line-level alterations and small studio beats, e.g. ep 90 (Hyunckel's deduction drops the manga's 'same speech and pronunciation as Vearn' reasoning), ep 91 (Him's '話が見えねえ' line cut to an expression), ep 92 (the manga's unattributed 'せっかく回復したのに' line given to Brokeena on screen), ep 93 (Calamity End drawn as an aura blade rather than a bare hand-chop; Him's line changed; the three fighters turn to Dai's voice before charging), ep 94 (Vearn's dropped-stance normal attacks, cut in the manga, are shown; 'pain' → 'fear'), ep 95 (the hexagram redrawn as a hexagon; the countdown changed from 5 to 10 minutes). No anime-original story share — every row stays canon.
